name: Aloo Puri
instructions: 1. Prepare the dough by mixing flour, a pinch of salt, and a tablespoon of oil with water, then let it rest for 20 minutes.
2. For the curry, heat oil in a pan, add cumin, mustard seeds, ginger, and green chilies.
3. Add chopped potatoes and spices (turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder) and sauté for 2 minutes.
4. Pour in 2 cups of water, add amchur and salt, and simmer until the gravy thickens; finish with garam masala and coriander.
5. Divide the dough into small balls, roll them into thin discs, and deep-fry in hot oil until they puff up and turn golden brown.
6. Serve hot with the prepared potato curry.
description: Aloo Puri is the quintessential Delhi street food breakfast. It represents the bustling morning culture of North India, where roadside stalls serve this soul-satisfying, spicy meal to everyone from office workers to students.
